Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Apex Modern Oversized Sofa Couch, 81"W, Ash Grey
Colors: Ash Grey
Materials: Hardwood
This chunky, oversized, mid-century-inspired modern design stands the test of time. With its squared shape and clean, simple lines, it can bridge the gap between classic and contemporary in your living room. 80.7"W x 37.8”D x 29.5”H Hardwood frame with reinforced corners At home in any room where a well-designed sofa is needed Simple assembly; just attach legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
